title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-03-10
body:
Applied ML weekly research notes — week of 2026-03-10

Attendees: Aisha (owner), Marco, Jenna, Oliver, Priya (remote)
Context: weekly sync + standup-style updates focused on quantization experiments, evaluation results, and model onboarding progress for recent open models (gptx-7b-v1 and opt-13b-2026).

1) Summary / decisions
- Continue with INT8 PTQ baseline for gptx-7b-v1; fallback to per-channel calibration if accuracy drop > 2.5% on eval-suite-2026.
- Start gated rollout for opt-13b-2026 on dedicated infra (low-traffic canary) — see AM-471 for rollout policy.

2) Quantization experiments (Marco)
- Ran INT8 symmetric PTQ on gptx-7b-v1 using 10k calibration tokens (internal-eval-2026). Latency down ~28% p50 on p4d-type nodes; throughput up ~35% for batching=8.
- Observed perplexity increase: +1.9% on eval-lm-core, and QA F1 drop ~1.7% on eval-qa-set. Within accept thresholds but need more slices (dialog+code) to validate.
- Planned follow-ups: per-channel INT8 and QAT micro-train: schedule PR QAT-experiments (AM-452).

3) Evals and metrics (Jenna)
- Unified eval harness produced standardized outputs for both float16 and int8 runs. Added latency/cost column to each eval artifact.
- Regression alert: for summarization-over-long-docs test, int8 shows ROUGE-L regression of 3.5% on long-doc slice (ticketed AM-486).
- Action: add targeted prompt set of 500 long-doc cases and run per-channel quant to see if regression reduces.

4) Model onboarding (Oliver)
- opt-13b-2026: container build completed; integration tests passing except multi-gpu KV-cache hang on sequence lengths >1024 (investigating; suspect kernel selection mismatch).
- Canary plan: route 5% traffic on dedicated pool after KV-cache fix; fallback to gptx-7b-v1 if error rate >1%. PR for serving-runtime changes opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/879

5) Risks / blockers
- QAT infra: lack of stable low-cost TPU/GPU for extended micro-training. SRE to provision 2x a100-80gb for 2 weeks (raised to infra team).
- Eval coverage gaps: conversational instruction-following and code-generation slices currently underrepresented. Need labeling help from solutions-eng.

6) Action items (owners)
- Marco: run per-channel INT8 and QAT micro-train for gptx-7b-v1 (target: initial results by 2026-03-17) [AM-452].
- Jenna: create targeted long-doc prompt set (500 cases) and run quantized evals; add dashboard panel for ROUGE-L by slice (due 2026-03-16).
- Oliver: root-cause KV-cache multi-gpu hang and patch serving-runtime; if not fixed by 2026-03-15, enable conservative sequence-length cap in canary.
- Aisha: coordinate infra request and customer-facing note for potential canary rollback scenarios.

7) Standup log snippets (short):
- 2026-03-10 09:00 Aisha: blocked on infra; requested a100 quota.
- 2026-03-10 09:10 Marco: quant baseline done; starting per-channel.
- 2026-03-10 09:15 Jenna: harness updates merged; dashboard stub added.
- 2026-03-11 09:00 Oliver: reproducing KV-cache hang; kernel mismatch hypothesis.

Notes to self / open questions:
- How aggressive should cost-vs-quality tradeoffs be for Hosted API customers? Need pricing team input before promoting INT8 defaults.
- Consider automated slice-based rollback if slice-level metric degrades >3% for 24h.

Related links and refs:
- quantization-eval-plan (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AM/quantization-eval-plan
- Tickets: AM-452 (QAT experiments), AM-471 (opt-13b onboard + rollout), AM-486 (summarization regression)
- PR: serving-runtime/pull/879

Next meeting: 2026-03-17 10:00 — bring per-channel INT8 results + targeted long-doc evals.

-- end of notes
